title: Models
body:
[[Waterfall]]
[[Agile]]

**Process models**: the different ways of arranging the [[SDLC]] phases. Not to be confused
with [[Modeling]], which is the analysis activity of drawing the problem (see that note; the
course uses both words).

| Model | Shape | Assumes |
|---|---|---|
| [[Waterfall]] | phases once, in order | requirements are known up front |
| [[Agile]] | all phases, every iteration | requirements will change |

Everything else in the space sits between those two poles: iterative models repeat the cycle
a fixed number of times, incremental models deliver the system in planned slices, and
spiral-style models add explicit risk assessment to each pass. The vault has no notes on
those; the course's contrast was Waterfall against Agile.
